subject: MAP: Security acceptance runway & archival policy alignment
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@lighthold.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: security@lighthold.com
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff & initial security asks

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was impressed with throughput and the routing options. We're ready to start a mutual action plan (MAP) to get to a signed contract. To keep legal/security alignment clean, can you confirm the following items this week?

1) SOC 2: we need the latest Type II report and a short list of what was in-scope (systems + time window).
2) SIG/CAIQ: a prefilled SIG/CAIQ or CAIQ export for your hosted offering would speed our review.
3) DPA: our legal team will send a redline. Who should we expect that from and where should they upload it?
4) Data residency & retention: we need to confirm default retention windows for logs, request payloads, and embeddings — plus options for custom retention for our EU customers.

We'd like to target a 4-week evaluation + legal review cadence: security review week 1, proof-of-concept week 2, SOC2 evidence confirmation week 3, legal finalization week 4. Is that feasible from your side?

I attached the high-level MAP template we use for other vendors. Please confirm owners and any blockers.

Thanks,
Elena
Director, Vendor Risk & Security
Lighthold Financial

Attachments: Lighthold_MAP_template_v2.pdf (referenced)

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@lighthold.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & initial security asks

Hi Elena — great to get this started.

Short answers up front: yes, the 4-week cadence is reasonable; we'll own SOC 2 & CAIQ prep and legal (DPA) will be handled by Kimberly.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
- Week 1 (security intake): Marcus will send a SOC 2 summary + prefilling plan for SIG/CAIQ.
- Week 2 (PoC): we'll provision a dedicated evaluation instance in us-west with restricted access and optional EU-residency variant for a canary subset.
- Week 3 (evidence): exchange of artifacts (SOC 2 Type II, logs sample, CAIQ answers).
- Week 4 (contract): legal redline & final signoff; Kimberly will coordinate DPA edits.

Owners: Marcus (security/evidence), Kimberly (legal/DPA), Avery (PM & timeline).

Open questions for your team:
- Does Lighthold require SOC 2 under NDA only, or will you accept SOC 2 under an encrypted share link?
- Any absolute no-go retention windows (e.g., <30 days) for production data?

I'm attaching our draft MAP that maps owners and acceptance criteria. Marcus and Kimberly — can you confirm your availability for a 30-minute sync Monday morning?

Cheers,
Avery Johnson
Head of Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MPA_v1.3.pdf (see sections 2-4 for acceptance criteria)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@lighthold.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & initial security asks

Elena — thanks, forwarding a short technical checklist and what we'll provide.

SOC 2 & evidence path (summary):
- We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report (most recent 12-month period) via an encrypted share link once the mutual NDA is in place. If you prefer, we can also provide a redacted copy in the initial exchange.
- Evidence items we'll prepare: control mapping, user access logs sampling (last 90 days), incident response summary, change control snapshot.

SIG/CAIQ approach:
- We'll start by exporting our CAIQ responses for the hosted product and mark any inapplicable controls. Expect a prefilled CSV and a human-readable CAIQ PDF.

Data retention windows (defaults & options):
- Request payloads: default 90 days; configurable down to 30 days on Dedicated/Private deployments.
- KV/embeddings cache: default 7 days; can be shortened to 0 (no persistent cache) for evaluation.
- Audit logs (authentication/authorization): default 365 days; archival options to S3-style object storage (customer-managed) for up to 7 years.

Technical canary request:
- We can create a limited EU-residency evaluation (subset of test tenants) if you need residency testing — will take 48–72 hours to provision.

I'll attach an evidence checklist spreadsheet (SOC2-evidence-list.xlsx) and a short readme. Avery — I'm free Monday 10:00–11:00am PT for the sync.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Lead Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-list.xlsx (control->artifact mapping)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@lighthold.com>

Cc: security@lighthold.com
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 12:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & initial security asks

Perfect — that plan is helpful. A few clarifications from Lighthold's side:

- NDA/SOC2 exchange: we do require an NDA before we accept any SOC 2 materials. Our procurement team will send a standard mutual NDA today; if you have a preferred secure share (e.g., Box/SharePoint link with encryption) please flag that.
- EU residency: we want the canary to demonstrate that logs and embeddings for EU test tenants are stored in the EU and do not leave region. That test will be part of Week 2 PoC acceptance criteria.
- Retention policy: 90/7/365 (requests/embeddings/audit logs) is in line with our baseline. We may ask for a carveout to 180 days for specific transaction logs — will note that in our MPA template.

Can you confirm the person Kim should expect to work with for the DPA? Also, can you attach a sample DPA (your standard) so our legal team can pre-review?

I'll circulate our proposed MAP milestones and a short list of regulatory checkpoints (PSD2+ equivalent obligations) for visibility.

Thanks,
Elena

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@lighthold.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & initial security asks — DPA & retention note

Hi Elena — Kimberly here from Legal. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

A few practical notes and next steps on the DPA and retention items:

1) DPA redline process:
- Please send the redline to DPA@redwood.com; I'll be the primary reviewer. We'll track changes in 'DPA_redline_avery_track.docx' (attached).
- Typical turnaround for an initial comment set is 3 business days. If you have nonstandard clauses (data escrow, escrow-approved third-party access), flag them up front.

2) Retention & archival options (proposed for MAP):
- Default production retention: request payloads 90 days, embeddings 7 days, audit logs 365 days.
- Evaluation exceptions: for PoC we can enable 30-day request retention and zero persistent embedding retention.
- EU residency: we support EU tenant isolation on Dedicated/Private; for hosted we can earmark an EU-only tenant for your canary.
- Long-term archival: we offer export-to-customer-s3 (encrypted) for up to 7 years; we can also agree to a 3rd-party escrow for stateful snapshots if required by regulation.

3) Compliance acceptance criteria to appear in the MAP (examples):
- SOC 2 Type II received and validated against control matrix.
- CAIQ prefilling completed and reviewed.
- EU residency verification via PoC (logs + embeddings) for a 48-hour window with signed report.
- DPA agreed and countersigned.

Next steps: I will upload a sample DPA (our standard) to the Drive link and comment inline for the clauses you usually redline. Avery, Marcus — please confirm you can join a 30-minute call Wednesday 9:00am PT to triage any legal/security blockers.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: DPA_redline_avery_track.docx (template + comments)
